newsitem.title: USA: C.R. Bard wins $10.8 mln in patent suit.
newsitem.headline: C.R. Bard wins $10.8 mln in patent suit.

text.p: C.R. Bard Inc said Tuesday a federal court jury awarded it $10.8 million in damages in a patent infringement suit against Boston Scientific Corp.

The jury determined an esophageal dilatation catheter sold by Boston Scientific's Microvasive Endoscopy division infringed a U.S. patent issued to Bard, a company statement said. The jury awarded Bard lost profits and other damages totaling $10.8 million, it added.
Esophageal dilatation catheters are used to treat strictures of the esophagus resulting from acid reflux disease, esophageal cancer and other causes, the manufacturer of health products said.
Boston Scientific officials and a C.R. Bard spokesman were not immediately available to elaborate on the suit.

Boston Scientific chief financial officer Larry Best said June 17 he was comfortable with a 1997 earnings forecast of $1.90 per share, compared with $1.54 last year. The company's stock opened at 59-1/2 Tuesday, up 5/8.
C.R. Bard opened at 35-5/8 Tuesday, up 1/8.
